question: If 20% of a number is added to 96, then the result is the same number. 80% of the same number is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let number = x

20% of x + 96 = x ⇒ 0.2x + 96 = x

⇒ 0.8x = 96 ⇒ x = 120

80% of x = 0.8 × 120

**∴ Answer = 96**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

20% of a number added to 96 equals the number

**Formula used:**

Percentage = (Part ÷ Whole) × 100

**Calculation:**

⇒ Let number = x

⇒ 20% of x = (20/100) × x = 0.2x

⇒ According to question:

⇒ 0.2x + 96 = x

⇒ x − 0.2x = 96

⇒ 0.8x = 96

⇒ x = 96 ÷ 0.8 = 120

⇒ 80% of x = 0.8 × 120

⇒ = 96

**∴ The correct answer is 96.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Percentage Conversion

x% = x/100

Equation Formation

Translate word problems into algebraic equations

Shortcut Insight

If 20% + 96 = 100%, then 80% = 96

Direct Logic

Remaining percentage gives direct value
